events.title: ARMA Fest 2026
events.venue_address: Jl. Raya Pengosekan, Peliatan, Ubud, Bali
events.short_description: Annual two-day art and culture festival at ARMA Museum celebrating Ubud's creative traditions — traditional crafts, contemporary art, live performance, and community gathering for the museum's 30th anniversary.
events.description: ARMA Fest 2026 returns to the Agung Rai Museum of Art for a two-day celebration of Ubud's living artistic heritage. Now in its 30th anniversary year, the festival spans September 19–20 across ARMA Museum & Resort's gardens and gallery spaces in Pengosekan. The programme brings together traditional Balinese craft, contemporary visual art, live music, and performance — a rare convergence of local artists and international guests in one of Ubud's most architecturally and culturally grounded settings. Previous editions have drawn hundreds across the weekend; 2026 is described as 'bigger and better than ever.'
events._curatorNote: Three independent press/news sources (Dewata News Jun 2026, The Bali Sun 2026, + multiple aggregators Hostelworld/AllEvents) all confirm Sep 19-20 2026 at ARMA Museum Pengosekan. armabali.com direct fetch blocked by sandbox proxy — page is indexed and exists, proxy-only block. 30th anniversary year per Dewata News ('part of ARMA's 30th anniversary celebrations'). Prior holds were aggregator-only; Dewata News + Bali Sun upgrades this to press-confirmed. Discovery tier: Art & Culture.
